spans.s:
mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं)
1 Wet, moist.
2 Kind, humane.
E.
उन्द to be moist, क्त aff.

r. 10th cl. (न) ऊनत् (ऊनयति)
1 To deduct or lessen.
2 To mete out in small quantities.
3 To measure.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Less in number, size or degree, as fewer, smaller, inferior, &c.
E.
ऊन to deduct, &c. affix क.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 High, tall.
2 Raised, held or lifted up.
3 Plump, full.
4 Great, eminent.
E.
उत् high, नत bent.

mfn. (-भिः-भिः-भि)
Corpulent.
E.
उन्नत high, and नाभि the navel.

mfn. (-राः-राः-रः)
Holding up the head, carrying the head high.
E.
उन्नत and शिरस् the head.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Uneven, undulating, wavy.
E.
उन्नत high, and आनत low.

f. (-तिः)
1 Increase, advancement, prosperity.
2 Rising, ascending.
3 The wife of GARUḌA.
E.
उत् up, नम to bend, क्तिन् aff.

m. (-शः)
A name of GARUḌA.
E.
उन्नति and ईष husband: the husband of UNNATI.

mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं)
1 Swelled, increased.
2 Tied upon or over.
3 Unbound.
E.
उद् before नह to bind, क्त aff.

n. (-नं)
Raising, lifting up.
E.
उत् before नम to bow, ल्युट् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Raised, elevated, lifted or pulled up.
2 Heightened, increased.
E.
उत् before नम to bow, क्त affix, with इट् augment.

ind.
Having raised.
E.
उत् before नम to bow, ल्यप् aff.

mfn. (-म्रः-म्रा-म्रं)
Lofty, high, elevated.
E.
उत् before नम to bow, रक aff.

m. (-यं)
1 Raising, elevating, hoisting.
2 Analogy, resemblance.
E.
उत् up, नी to obtain, and अच् aff.

m. (-यः)
Raising.
E.
see उन्नय, affix घञ्.

n. (-नं)
1 Deliberation, discussion, logic, reasoning.
2

Inference.
3

Raising, elevating, lifting up.
E.
उत् up, नी to obtain, affix ल्युट्.

mfn. (-सः-सा-सं)
Having a prominent nose.
E.
उद् up, नस for नासिका the nose.

m. (-मः)
Raising, lifting up.
E.
उद् and नम to bow, घञ् aff.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
1 What raises.
2 What leads to an inference or conclusion.
E.
उद् before नी to get, causal form, वुन् aff.

n. (-हं)
Sour gruel made from the fermentation of rice.
E.
उद् and नह to bind, affix घञ्.
